yoshi_egg.notes: mariowiki: hidden block above the platform immediately following the third moving lift - NOTE: base level text only describes 2 lifts, wiki's challenge-mode note references a 'third moving lift', inconsistency flagged for rom verification

smbd_deltas: no smbd-specific terrain/block layout changes for 1-3 were found in the sources used, beyond the standard challenge-mode additions. the yoshi-egg note's reference to a 'third moving lift' does not match the base-level description of only two horizontally moving lifts - this needs resolving against the rom (possibly smbd adds a third lift, or the wiki source itself is imprecise).
confidence_notes: all x/y coordinates are sequence-derived placeholders per SCHEMA.md, not measured from map images. island y-heights are approximate relative guesses ('tallest', 'shorter', 'wide/tall') translated into row numbers, not sourced heights. the single ? block, coin count (23 total, 21 needed for a world-2-1 1-up bonus), and all enemy kinds/counts are sourced from mariowiki text. the yoshi-egg 'third lift' inconsistency is the main must-verify item for this level.
